scope: Green Modern 2 strokes translated (2048,2048), map16, view 1728x1024 at (2048,2300), explicit 512 MiB. Two alternating stroke-release pairs, not full LP6/default-budget acceptance.

notes: Paint endpoint is canvas draw completion, not physical display scanout.

First changed pixels compares tile RGBA after timing stops, replaying retained immutable bitmaps; no pixel readback runs on the measured path. Extra observer bitmap memory and untimed comparison cost are reported.

Pointer tiles use rendered art coordinates, not the inverse-projected ground pick. Whole current uses union coverage of actual opaque painted clips, from tiles or blocks, and weather readiness, never bake frequency.
Pass timestamps cannot assign a mixed on/off-screen pass to individual pixels; wholly outside time is exact, mixed and area-weighted estimates are separate.
Final latency samples include held mid-drag pauses and release; uncompleted pauses are censored.
No editor files are changed; Fetch injects timing-only observers before modules execute.

resumeProbes.method: External copies of repro/perf.mjs retain all original endpoints. One uses 600 ms instead of 100 ms; the second also waits for finalizing && renderer.busy && foregroundPending and skips the unrelated initial drag. The repository bench remains unchanged. These are not the standard LP0/LP4 100-ms Time-in-flight acceptance run.
